emcap-alchemy-2:ashbyhq:07f23db8-28b1-49.title: Technical Recruiter
emcap-alchemy-2:ashbyhq:07f23db8-28b1-49.description: ABOUT ALCHEMY Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. From enabling $1+ trillion in financial transactions worldwide to scaling L2s and enabling DeFi, Alchemy provides the infrastructure and tools developers need to build reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences. Trusted by companies like JPMorgan, Stripe, Visa, Franklin Templeton, Nike, and backed by a16z, Coatue, Silver Lake, Lightspeed, and Stanford University, Alchemy is building the foundational layer for a decentralized and AI-enabled Web3 ecosystem. For more information, visit alchemy.com http://alchemy.com. ABOUT THE ROLE Talent is Alchemy's greatest competitive advantage. As a Technical Recruiter, you'll be responsible for identifying, attracting, and closing exceptional technical talent across the company. You'll partner directly with engineering and product leaders to understand business needs, develop recruiting strategies, and build high-performing teams capable of solving some of the most complex challenges in infrastructure, distributed systems, AI, and blockchain technology. This is a highly strategic and visible role with significant impact on Alchemy's future. You'll help shape the technical organization, influence hiring decisions, and serve as a trusted advisor to leaders across the company. If you're passionate about building elite technical teams, thrive in fast-moving environments, and enjoy competing for top talent in highly competitive markets, we'd love to meet you. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own full-cycle recruiting across technical functions, including Software Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Product Engineering, Security, Data, Product Management, Design, and Technical Operations. - Partner closely with engineering and product leaders to understand organizational priorities and develop hiring strategies aligned with company goals. - Build and manage high-quality candidate pipelines through sourcing, networking, referrals, talent mapping, and community engagement. - Identify and engage exceptional passive candidates from top technology companies, startups, and research institutions. - Drive candidate engagement and deliver an exceptional candidate experience from initial outreach through offer acceptance. - Serve as a trusted advisor to hiring teams on talent market trends, compensation benchmarks, interview design, and hiring best practices. - Partner with interviewers and hiring managers to maintain a high hiring bar while ensuring efficient and inclusive hiring processes. - Leverage recruiting data and funnel analytics to identify opportunities and improve hiring outcomes. - Help build scalable recruiting programs, interviewer training, assessment frameworks, and recruiting operations. - Champion Alchemy's culture and values throughout every stage of the recruiting process. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - 5+ years of full-cycle technical recruiting experience in a high-growth technology company, executive search firm, or recruiting agency. - Demonstrated success hiring software engineers and technical talent across multiple levels, from early-career hires through senior and staff-level candidates. - Strong sourcing skills and a track record of engaging passive technical candidates in competitive talent markets. - Experience recruiting for highly technical domains such as infrastructure, distributed systems, backend engineering, machine learning, AI, security, developer tools, or platform engineering. - Ability to develop credibility and influence with engineering, product, and executive stakeholders. - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills. - Ability to operate independently and manage multiple high-priority searches simultaneously. - Strong analytical mindset with experience using recruiting metrics to drive decision-making. - High standards, strong ownership mentality, and relentless focus on outcomes. NIC

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:f6f0093e-431.title: Demand Generation Marketer
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:f6f0093e-431.description: Wing is seeking elite talent to join M32 AI (backed by top-tier Silicon Valley VCs), dedicated to building agentic AI for traditional service businesses. Think of it like a startup within a corporate: fast moving and agile, with the stability of a corporate, and zero bureaucracy. If you’re driven by challenge and eager to make a significant impact in a high-caliber role, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. We're hiring a Field & Events Marketer to own our presence at industry events, tradeshows, and conferences across North America. You'll source the right shows, run them end to end, and be the person on the ground making sure every event drives real pipeline. This is a hands-on role for someone 1-4 years into their career who loves logistics, thrives in fast-paced environments, and gets a kick out of pulling off a great event. You'll partner closely with sales, marketing, and product to turn booth space and badge scans into meetings, opportunities, and closed revenue. Why This Role You'll own a high-visibility function from day one. Every event is a chance to shape how customers, prospects, and the industry see us. If you want to grow fast, take real ownership, and build a portfolio of events you're genuinely proud of, this is the seat for you.
responsibilities: Source and prioritize events. Research, evaluate, and recommend tradeshows, conferences, and industry events that align with our ICP and revenue goals. Own a rolling 12-month event calendar.
Negotiate and contract. Manage relationships with event organizers, vendors, and venues. Negotiate sponsorships, booth space, speaking slots, and add-ons to stretch every dollar.
Plan and execute end to end. Own every detail, including booth design and shipping, swag, collateral, lead capture, badge scanners, AV, catering, hotel blocks, and travel logistics for the team.
Be the on-site point of contact. Attend every event in person. Set up and tear down booths, troubleshoot in real time, and make sure our presence looks sharp from start to finish.
Prep the team. Brief attending team members on objectives, talking points, target accounts, and logistics. Make sure everyone knows where to be, when, and what to do.
Drive pipeline with sales. Partner with sales to book pre-show meetings, run dinners and customer events on-site, and ensure every lead is captured, qualified, and followed up on quickly.
Run pre- and post-event campaigns. Work with marketing on email outreach, landing pages, paid promotion, and social to drive booth traffic and meeting bookings before the show.
Own the budget. Manage event spend across the full calendar. Track costs, forecast accurately, flag risks early, and make smart trade-off decisions when priorities shift.
Define KPIs and report on results. Set clear KPIs for each event (leads, meetings, pipeline, ROI) and build clean post-event reports that show what worked, what didn't, and how to improve next time.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:54f966b5-0b35-.title: Analista Financeiro Sênior
jobgether-jobgether:lever:54f966b5-0b35-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Analista Financeiro Sênior based in Brazil. This is a senior finance opportunity for a professional who can operate across treasury, controlling, and accounting while maintaining a strong focus on accuracy and business impact. You will take ownership of cash management, financial closing routines, reconciliations, and accounts payable in a dynamic environment. The role also involves consolidating financial information, supporting external audits, and producing management reports that enable better decision-making. A key part of the position will be improving and automating financial processes to strengthen controls and support scalable growth. You will work closely with internal stakeholders and external accounting partners, requiring autonomy, organization, and strong analytical judgment. This is a fully remote opportunity suited to someone who enjoys combining operational execution with continuous process improvement. Manage treasury routines, including daily cash control, cash-flow projections, liquidity management, and banking transactions. Own the end-to-end Accounts Payable process, from document verification through the monitoring and execution of domestic and international payments. Perform rigorous bank and financial reconciliations, ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of financial records. Lead monthly financial closing activities, including balance analysis, validations, and direct support to controlling processes. Work closely with external accounting partners to ensure transactions are correctly recorded and financial statements maintain a high level of quality. Prepare management reports covering cash flow, financial position, and key indicators, translating financial data into actionable insights for leadership. Support external audits by organizing documentation, evidence, explanations, and technical information efficiently. Identify opportunities to automate and standardize financial processes, mapping operational gaps and strengthening internal controls. Monitor multiple priorities and proactively identify financial risks, discrepancies, and opportunities for process improvement. Contribute to the continuous improvement of finance operations while maintaining strong standards of accuracy, organization, and compliance. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, Engineering , or a related field. Solid professional experience in Treasury and Controlling . Proven experience with cash-flow management, Accounts Payable, financial reconciliations, financial closing, and financial statements. Advanced Excel skills and professional English proficiency. Strong analytical and organizational abilities, with a structured and solution-oriented approach to problem-solving. Ability to work autonomously in a dynamic environment with multiple priorities and changing demands. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy across high-volume financial processes. Good communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working across finance, accounting, and other business functions. Experience in fintechs, financial institutions, or technology companies is a plus. Familiarity with financial ERP systems and process automation tools is desirable. Benefits: Fully remote work. Meal and food allowance through CAJU. Gympass/TotalPass access. Health and dental insurance. Opportunities for professional growth and career development. Access to the Alura learning platform. Sesc benefits. Inclusive and open work environment where employees are encouraged to contribute ideas and suggestions. Opportunity to work across treasury, controlling, accounting, and financial process automation in a technology-driven environment. The PI Behavioral Assessment isnot a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Commissions are paid every pay period - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek high-energy personalities that thrive in a fast-paced environment to provide a welcoming atmosphere for our Unlimited Wash Pass Members and a memorable first impression on our new car wash guests. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated and have an outgoing, friendly personality. All we ask is for you to share our passion for washing cars, creating memorable moments, and our obsession with exceptional guest service!
